summary: Complaints centre on daily power cuts, waterlogging in the town and a filthy fruit and vegetable mandi, while the main appreciation is a road widening that is under way and relief and cane payments reported at district level.

positives.english: The Dadri to Bulandshahr to Sikandrabad road is being widened with a median and drains
positives.hindi: दादरी से सिकंदराबाद तक सड़क चौड़ी हो रही है, डिवाइडर और नाले बन रहे हैं
positives.basis: Work described as 'चौड़ीकरण का काम तेजी से चल रहा है'; divider, two lanes each side and drains being built; no length stated; power pole removal only proposed (funds deposited)

positives.english: Village roads along the rajwaha canals near Sikandrabad were started after a foundation stone was laid
positives.hindi: सिकंदराबाद क्षेत्र में रजवाहे किनारे गांवों की सड़कों का काम शुरू हुआ
positives.basis: Foundation stone laid at Arnia Kamalpur village; four rajwaha road projects listed (e.g. Vair Rajwaha km 3.30 to 8.30, road construction); 'कार्य शुरू किए गए हैं'; completion not reported; article is datelined Sikandrabad and names the Sikandrabad constituency; funding amount not stated

positives.english: Farmers got crop loss relief certificates after the late September rain
positives.hindi: सितंबर की भारी बारिश से फसल खराब हुई, किसानों को राहत प्रमाण पत्र मिले
positives.basis: District-level: certificates distributed at Bulandshahr collectorate for damage from rain on 25 to 27 September 2026 under State Disaster Mitigation Fund; number of farmers and amount not stated; no village or tehsil named

positives.english: Sugar mills in Bulandshahr say they paid farmers the full cane price
positives.hindi: चीनी मिलों ने गन्ने का पूरा पैसा किसानों के बैंक खातों में भेज दिया
positives.basis: District-level: 'चारों चीनी मिलों ने ... 100 प्रतिशत भुगतान' for 2025-26 season, over Rs 1,092 crore paid; Sikandrabad not mentioned; mills named include Sabitgarh, Pahasu, Anamika, Agauta, Wave and Di Kisan (none confirmed inside this AC)

positives.english: A new road of about 10 crore was built in Sikandrabad earlier this year
positives.hindi: सिकंदराबाद में करीब 10 करोड़ की नई सड़क बनी थी
positives.basis: Article states the road in Sikandrabad was built at about Rs 10 crore and was dug up by Jal Nigam about four months after construction, so the benefit was short lived; the damage is the article's main point, see negatives

negatives.english: Power in Sikandrabad goes off every 15 to 25 minutes during heat and overload
negatives.hindi: सिकंदराबाद में हर 15 से 25 मिनट पर बिजली गुल हो जाती है
negatives.basis: 'हर 15 से 25 मिनट पर बिजली गुल हो जाती है'; causes listed as tripping, overload, faults and low voltage; 33 faults reported to the power corporation in the Sikandrabad area; cuts of 2 to 8 hours in town and rural areas

negatives.english: Waterlogging fills all the mohallas of Sikandrabad town in rain
negatives.hindi: बारिश में सिकंदराबाद के सभी मोहल्लों में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Article on 9 July 2026 rain: 'सिकंदराबाद नगर के सभी मोहल्लों के अलावा औद्योगिक क्षेत्र और तहसील परिसर' affected by waterlogging, including the tehsildar's residence; Sikandrabad recorded 75 mm rain; district-wide report, Sikandrabad named as a tehsil

negatives.english: The Sikandrabad mandi is full of filth and its taps are broken
negatives.hindi: सिकंदराबाद मंडी में गंदगी का अंबार है, नल खराब पड़े हैं
negatives.basis: Fruit and vegetable mandi on Sikandrabad GT Road: 'गंदा पानी, कूड़े के ढेर'; 'मंडी में लगे नल खराब पड़े हैं'; stray animals and drinking water problems cited; commission agents announced an indefinite strike until sanitation, drainage and drinking water are fixed; strike status after 14 Aug not confirmed

negatives.english: A child died from a transformer left on an unpaved road in Sikandrabad, villagers allege
negatives.hindi: कच्चे रास्ते पर रखे ट्रांसफार्मर से बच्चे की मौत, आरोप है शिकायत अनसुनी हुई
negatives.basis: Five-year-old died of electric shock in Kala Pir mohalla, Sikandrabad kotwali; villagers allege the transformer lay on the unpaved road for many days and repeated requests to remove it were ignored (allegation)

negatives.english: Workers at a Sikandrabad factory protest 12-hour shifts and pay of about 8000 a month
negatives.hindi: 12 घंटे की ड्यूटी, महिला कर्मियों को सिर्फ 8 हजार रुपए वेतन
negatives.basis: Workers at a private company in Sikandrabad industrial area protested low pay and 12-hour shifts, demanding Rs 15,000 (women) and Rs 20,000 (men); one worker said she gets Rs 8,000; company name not stated; workers returned after officials' assurance

notes: AC confirmed via Wikipedia list (no. 64 Sikandrabad, Bulandshahr, General). Extent per Sikandrabad Assembly constituency page: all of Sikandrabad tehsil plus named areas (Peerbiyavani, Chhapravat, Baral, Sainta, Kurli) and parts of Agouta KC and Gulaothi MB; one mirror omits Peerbiyavani. Positive 4 (cane payments) and the crop relief item are district-level, not AC-specific. The Sikandrabad mill is not confirmed. Positive 2 village (Arnia Kamalpur) is not verified against the extent list; included on the strength of the news report naming the Sikandrabad constituency. The Dadri to Sikandrabad widening is confirmed as a project toward Sikandrabad, but the exact stretch inside the AC is not stated. Positive 5 is a Sikandrabad road built but later dug up, so the appreciation is weak. Mandi strike status after mid-August 2026 is unknown; a Royal Bulletin report on a strike ending concerns the Navin fruit and vegetable mandi, not this one, so it is excluded. Excluded as not in this AC: Amar Ujala Rs 24 crore Madhuban-Bapudham works (Ghaziabad), Hapur and Khurja waterlogging reports, and a Khurja GT Road drain story. Excluded as weak or unverified: a social media post on a jan sunwai complaint and the Sikandrabad power grid aggregator items. Field check suggested: Sikandrabad nagar drains and the Kala Pir transformer, the GT Road mandi, and the status of the Dadri to Sikandrabad widening.
